**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Identify what the other agent is working on in the brain repo, take a non-interfering ticket in parallel from the prioritization handoff, in an isolated worktree off `main`, following brain doctrine.

## Instructions
- User requirement: never break or interfere with the other agent's work.
- Parallel work must go in a separate worktree branched from `main`.
- Ticket selection must follow `docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md`.

## Discoveries
- The other agent holds TWO live fronts: PR #693 (issue #673, `actor-check` deny branch, 10/10 gates green, awaiting cold review) in `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-673`; and issue #676 point 2 (structural test over the 30 signed ADRs) in `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-676` — `openspec/changes/issue-676-adr-structural-invariant/{proposal,spec}.md` written 2026-08-16 10:50/10:53, still untracked. #676 was reopened 13:47 "for point 2 only" because PR #692's `Closes #676 (part 1)` closed the whole ticket.
- No other openspec change folder is alive: everything else under `openspec/changes/` is committed on `main`; the newest, `issue-690-controls-declare-what-did-not-run`, merged as PR #691.
- Row 4 of the handoff (`#599 → #312`) was REJECTED as the parallel pick: it can add a file to `brain/project/decisions/`, which would move the count under the other agent's born-green ADR test. Real interference, not theoretical.
- The prioritization handoff is stale on labels: it lists #600 as unsigned, but #600 now carries `status:approved`.
- `brain:ship` cannot open a PR for ANY branch `brain:ticket:start` creates — `ticket-start.mjs:111` emits `{type}/issue-{N}-{slug}` (the shape AGENTS.md:218 documents) and `brain-ship.mjs:83` matches `/\/(\d+)-/`. One rule, two implementations. Reported in PR #695's body; needs a human signature to become a ticket.
- #639's own stated repro was WRONG. Its "demonstrated bypass" (a ```js snippet above the block) was already green by accident: `FENCE_RE` skips a tagged foreign opener, latches onto that block's closing fence and swallows through to the graph block, where `scalar`'s `^protocol:` anchor still finds the key. The genuinely red shapes are an UNTAGGED ``` fence and a ```yaml fence of another protocol.
- Live impact of #639 measured over all 312 issues: 2 bodies mention `brain-graph/1` (#639, #533), both in prose; 0 carry a declared block; 0 nodes recovered. Reachable shape, not a live incident — which the ticket explicitly required stating.

## Accomplished
- Took issue #639 (`status:approved`, `type:bug`) — the first agent-doable item in row 5 of the handoff, zero file overlap with the other agent.
- Worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-639`, branch `fix/issue-639-fixstatus-parsegraphblock-reads-the-firs`, created off `main` via `brain:ticket:start --worktree --base main`.
- `parseGraphBlock` now locates through `fencedBlocks` and selects on the `protocol:` scalar; two blocks return `{ ok: false, error }` naming the count and body lines; `buildGraph` carries `blocksUnreadable` and `renderSummary` prints it distinct from "Sin ubicar".
- Six new tests. Red-proof: 5 of 6 go red with `epic-graph.mjs` reverted; the sixth is the already-green pin, labelled as such in the test file.
- Full suite 3827 pass / 0 fail. `brain:repo:check` and `brain:nav` clean.
- Memory record `rec-4520bce767ad25ed` scoped to #639, shared and committed.
- **PR #695 opened, all 10 gates SUCCESS.** Delivered without a self-review pass, per protocol.

## Next Steps
- PR #695 needs a COLD review (the only finder in this repo) and a human approval — `actor-check` forbids self-approval.
- The `brain:ship` / `brain:ticket:start` branch-grammar mismatch needs a human-signed ticket; an agent cannot apply `status:approved`.
- Handoff `docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md` is now stale on its "0 open PRs" invariant (2 open: #693, #695) and on #600's label.

## Relevant Files
- brain/scripts/status/epic-graph.mjs — locator now reads the protocol scalar, not the position; `blocksUnreadable` added
- brain/scripts/status/epic-render.mjs — `renderSummary` prints unreadable graph blocks on their own line
- brain/scripts/status/epic-map.test.mjs — six #639 cases including the labelled already-green pin
- openspec/changes/issue-639-graph-block-locator/{proposal,spec,tasks}.md — the artifact trail
- brain/scripts/brain-ship.mjs:83 — the branch-grammar half that disagrees with AGENTS.md:218
